hero.title: Every person has a story.
hero.subtitle: Hamqadam is built to make matrimonial matchmaking more meaningful, purposeful, and trustworthy — rooted in family dignity, deep compatibility, and verified authenticity.

purpose.title: Why We Built Hamqadam
purpose.description: Matrimony in our culture is not an impulsive transaction. It is the coming together of two hearts, two destinies, and two families. Yet modern matchmaking has become chaotic, impersonal, and unverified.

compare.title: Noisy, Unverified Directories
points: Unverified accounts, fictitious bios, and phantom profiles causing distress to hopeful families.
Superficial metrics prioritizing caste labels and unrealistic demands over character and emotional maturity.
Public directories exposing personal contact information to unvetted strangers and commercial brokers.
Endless swipes engendered for ad views, treating sacred lifelong commitments like consumable games.

compare.title: A Dignified, Private Sanctuary
points: 100% CNIC & Live Selfie Verification: Every member is authenticated before they can view or contact anyone.
Holistic Personhood: Profiles narrate passions, worldview, intellectual aspirations, and domestic values.
Family Respect & Guardian Integration: Transparent elder involvement, consultation concierges, and verified wali channels.
Intelligent Ethical AI: Thoughtful recommendations model surface preferences alongside alignment, not addictive feeds.

features.title: Purpose Over Product
features.description: Meaningful lifelong unions, not addictive swipe queues. Every interaction is designed with marriage and lasting harmony as the only finish line.

features.title: 100% ID & Face Verification
features.description: Zero fake profiles, zero impersonation. Rigorous government document validation and real-time biometric selfies ensure genuine matrimonial intent.

features.title: Respect for Family Dignity
features.description: Matrimony is an honorable family alliance. We offer dedicated family concierge consultations, verified guardian accounts, and private viewing controls.

features.title: Technology with Empathy
features.description: AI matchmaking is tailored for authentic lifestyle, career aspirations, spiritual cadence, and psychological compatibility; not cold checklists.

origin.title: “We did not start Hamqadam to build another dating app. We built Hamqadam because our siblings, children, and friends deserved a place where marriage was treated with reverence.”
origin.description: In a world accelerated by rapid micro-interactions, we paused to ask: what happened to intentional courtship? Hamqadam restores the timeless beauty of marriage consultations through the pinnacle of modern technology and absolute identity protection.

philosophy.title: Our Core Philosophy
philosophy.description: Four foundational convictions shape every algorithm we develop, every verification protocol we enforce, and every screen we design.

cards.title: Apple Philosophy — Simplicity with Purpose
cards.description: We rigorously eliminate visual friction, noisy banners, and intrusive advertisements. Every button, every typography choice, and every white-space margin serves the human heart. Finding a life partner demands clear contemplation, not digital overstimulation.
cards.footnote: Clarity over Clutter • Calmness over Urgency

cards.title: Storytelling — Every Person Has a Story
cards.description: A human soul cannot be condensed into age, height, and caste. Instead of profiling via crude personal journeys, intellectual passions, career dreams, parenting values, and family traditions — enabling compatibility built on authentic character.

cards.title: Start With WHY — Purpose Before Product
cards.description: We do not measure our success by daily active time spent on the app, but by meaningful unions formed and joyful marriages celebrated. Our business model rewards matches that graduate into lifelong homes, holding ourselves to ethical stewardship.

cards.title: Create the Future — Reinventing Matchmaking
cards.description: Pioneering intelligent compatibility models, automated toxicity filters, NADRA-aligned identity validation, and discreet privacy controls. We are modernizing Pakistani and South Asian matrimonial practices across the homeland and the global diaspora.
cards.footnote: Global Diaspora Access • Safe Identity Mitigation

beliefs.title: What We Believe
beliefs.description: Principles that govern our team, our code, and our community stewardship every single day.

items.title: Meaningful Connections Matter
items.description: Marriage is sacred. Casual encounters cannot satisfy the profound human desire for emotional safety, spiritual harmony, and an enduring home.

items.title: Trust Comes First
items.description: Without authentic identities and verifiable accountability, no real vulnerability is possible. We invest heavily in human verification because peace of mind is priceless.

items.title: Every Person Deserves to Be Understood
items.description: We reject narrow prejudices. Each individual brings unique aspirations, personal histories, and familial contexts that deserve compassionate, open-hearted listening.

items.title: Technology Should Simplify, Not Complicate
items.description: Our interface fades into the background so meaningful conversations can emerge. We build tools that save hours of distraction and bring warmth back.

items.title: AI Should Support People, Not Replace Human Judgment
items.description: Algorithms surface compatibility signals, but the final, heartfelt decision remains with the prospective partners and their trusted families.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.intro: To curate genuine, safe matrimonial opportunities without the hazards of superficial dating platforms, Hamqadam gathers deliberate personal information solely designated for dignified matchmaking.

cards.title: Personal & Lineage Context
cards.description: Legal name, age, gender, marital history, mother tongue, sectarian school of thought, caste/sub-caste, parental preferences, and current living arrangements.

cards.title: Academic & Professional
cards.description: Highest verified degrees, institution (e.g. LUMS, NUST, King Edward, PU), career sector, organization name, and verified income brackets.

cards.title: Family Architecture
cards.description: Parent and guardian professions, number of children, existing siblings, education, and family expectations for mutual household respect.

cards.title: Verification Crypts
cards.description: Government CNIC/NICOP/Passport and live selfie photographs, face camera biometrics, and phone number SMS OTP timestamps.

sections.notice: Sanctuary Pledge: We operate strictly on an intentional life-partnership framework. We never scrape external address books, social media graph connections, or unapproved device telemetry.

sections.title: Identity Documents Safeguards (CNIC & Selfie)
sections.intro: Hamqadam enforces Pakistan's most stringent identity verification standard. To maintain 100% genuine members and prevent catfishing or fraudulent proposals, identity validation is strictly contained within air-gapped security boundaries.

cards.title: Identity Vault Architecture
cards.description: Live Selfie / CNIC → Isolated AES Vault → Compliance Audit

sections.notice: No Public Exposure: Your CNIC numbers, scanned identity images and verification selfie scores are never visible to other users, matches, or third parties under any circumstances.
bullets: Restricted Physical Access: Only government-compliance vetted verification officers can access the encrypted vault during account validation sessions.
Automated Watermarking: All uploaded proof documents receive an indelible cryptographic watermark stating Hamqadam Internal Matrimonial Audit Only.

sections.title: Profile Visibility & Photo Privacy Controls
sections.intro: Dignity begins with complete control over your public presence. Hamqadam affords granular choice over every photograph and familial dimension of your proposal.

cards.title: Photo Blur by Choice
cards.description: Display your portrait with an intentional aesthetic frosted veil before secure mutual validation.

cards.title: Contact Shield
cards.description: Direct phone numbers and WhatsApp access remain 100% masked until both prospective families mutually agree to private communication.

cards.title: Incognito Browsing
cards.description: Explore prospective candidate profiles without triggering visit notifications or displaying your identity, subject to eligibility.

cards.title: Family-Managed Profiles
cards.description: When a parent, brother, or sister manages the account, the primary contact recipient is routed exclusively to the designated family elder to safeguard candidate boundaries.

sections.title: Responsible AI Processing & Data Protection
sections.intro: Our AI Matchmaking engine evaluates compatibility across lifestyle tenets, cultural harmony, education, and mutual life vision. This intelligence is strictly encapsulated.

cards.title: Zero Public Model Training
cards.description: Your biographical notes, interests, and private contact details are never exported to public-language models. Our closed-loop algorithms operate strictly within secure instances.

cards.title: Non-Intrusive Behavioral Scoring
cards.description: Match predictions derive exclusively from attributes you explicitly specify. We reject manipulative psychological scoring and external tracking.

sections.notice: Database Salt & Hashes: Argon2id for passwords, AES-GCM for profile-sensitive metadata. Audited Monthly.

sections.title: Zero-Spam & Zero-Harassment Protocol
sections.intro: Hamqadam does not operate programmatic advertising networks. We never sell, lease, or syndicate member contact databases to commercial brokers, marketing agencies, or unrelated real estate/financial providers.

cards.title: No Unsolicited Marketing
cards.description: Your phone number and email remain strictly shielded from account security alerts and legitimate match notifications you configure.

cards.title: Immediate Harassment Ban
cards.description: Inappropriate conduct, unsanctioned photo solicitation or disrespect leads to immediate permanent hardware-level and CNIC banishment.

sections.title: Account Deletion & Right to Erasure
sections.intro: The supreme joy of Hamqadam is when you no longer need us. Whether you find your eternal companion through our sanctuary or decide to depart for any reason, your right to permanent oblivion is honored with speed.

cards.title: Stage 01 — One-Click Request
cards.description: Trigger account deletion directly in your Profile Settings or email our Data Protection team.

cards.title: Stage 02 — Instant Unlisting
cards.description: Your bio, photos, and match records vanish from search matrices and public indices in real time.

cards.title: Stage 03 — Vault Shredding
cards.description: Within 14 calendar days, identity photos, CNIC scans, and encrypted records undergo permanent zero-fill deletion, subject to legal obligations.

sections.title: Bona Fide Matrimonial Intent
sections.intro: Hamqadam ('Rishton ki duniya') is conceived and operated strictly as a sanctified platform dedicated solely to lawful, solemn matrimonial commitments. Registration is granted exclusively to individuals and families who seek lifelong marital partnerships grounded in dignity, Islamic and civic ethics, and mutual honor.
sections.notice: Casual dating, non-marital solicitation, escorting, commercial matchmaking, visa barter, deceptive matchmaking syndicates, or speculative relationships are forbidden. Any such activity results in irreversible, instant account termination and permanent hardware/CNIC blacklisting without refund.
sections.closing: By maintaining an active profile or creating a submission for a son, daughter, sibling, or charge under your guardianship, you solemnly certify that your intent remains purely matrimonial and compliant with local family jurisprudence.

sections.title: Eligibility & Age of Consent
sections.intro: To register with Hamqadam, prospective brides and grooms must meet the minimum legal age of marriage recognized by the Child Marriage Restraint Act and applicable domestic laws.
bullets: Minimum Age: 18 continuous years of age for female registrants, and 18 or 21 continuous years depending on provincial jurisdiction; verify current local law before publication.
Marital Capacity: Applicants must have the legal, physical, and psychological competence to contract a marriage without duress or coercion.
Family Representative Access: Profiles created on behalf of a son, daughter, brother, or sister remain bound to the verified consent of the candidate whose identity is represented.

sections.title: Mandatory Identity Verification (100% CNIC / ID)
sections.intro: To maintain our sacred standard as the Sanctuary of Dignified Matrimony, Hamqadam enforces an uncompromised multi-layered verification system. An unverified account holds zero search visibility and cannot initiate member correspondence.

cards.title: CNIC / Passport Protocol
cards.description: Scanned valid government ID (National Identity Card / Passport). Uploaded proof is protected through encrypted access controls.

cards.title: Live Biometric Liveness Check
cards.description: A real-time camera selfie verification reduces the risk of photograph substitution and impersonation.

sections.closing: All registrants warrant that declarations regarding university credentials, employment sector, income brackets, caste/sect, and previous marital statuses are completely accurate. Supplying forged documentation constitutes legal fraud.

sections.title: Code of Conduct & Dignity Rules
sections.intro: Every communication across Hamqadam — whether encrypted chat messages, voice introductions, or guardian inquiries — must preserve the highest standards of decorum, courtesy, and respect.
bullets: Harassment & Pressure: Repeatedly messaging a recipient who has declined interest, making aggressive demands for private photos, or expressing unsolicited vulgar remarks is strictly forbidden.

Hate Speech & Sectarian Bias: Hamqadam welcomes diverse schools of thought, sects, and cultural traditions. Derogatory assertions targeting sectarian, linguistic, or ethnic backgrounds trigger account freezing.

AI Safety Monitoring: Proprietary natural language algorithms continuously review interactions for harassment flags, solicitations, or extortion indicators, escalating critical breaches to our Safety Desk.

sections.title: Membership Packages & Coins Policy
sections.intro: Hamqadam operates transparent matrimonial tiers structured to protect candidate privacy while fostering genuine matches. The platform implements an internal Coin System that governs interaction quotas and direct contact views.
sections.notice: Coins are consumptive digital utility tokens utilized to unlock direct communications, trigger priority matching algorithms, and submit guardian introductions. Coins possess no real-world monetary redemption value and cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred between accounts.
sections.closing: Contact Views: Unlocking verified telephone numbers and guardian coordinates requires the explicit bilateral mutual approval of the prospective member or their designated guardian.

sections.title: Account Suspension & Reporting
sections.intro: Hamqadam reserves the full unilateral prerogative to suspend, freeze, or terminate profiles reported for non-compliance. Our investigative procedure functions with high urgency.

cards.title: Immediate Freeze
cards.description: Upon receiving 2 distinct member reports or critical safety tickets, chat capabilities are instantly quarantined.

cards.title: Documented Audit
cards.description: The Trust & Safety Desk investigates uploaded logs, reported messages, and cross-checks NADRA/CNIC records.

cards.title: Definitive Resolution
cards.description: Guilty profiles face indefinite exclusion, blacklisting, or restitution of paid coins.

sections.title: Disclaimers & Limitation of Liability
sections.intro: While Hamqadam enforces 100% ID and facial liveness verification to eliminate deceptive imposters, Hamqadam does not guarantee the emotional compatibility, moral fortitude, personal temperament, or ultimate marital success of any registered user.
sections.notice: Families and candidates are strictly advised to carry out standard traditional and independent inquiries, family background checks, and safety verification before formalizing any matrimonial pact or exchanging personal assets.
sections.closing: To the fullest extent permitted under law, Hamqadam and its operators shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, punitive, or consequential damages resulting from off-platform meetings, unauthorized financial transfers between members, or personal disagreements.

sections.title: Dispute Resolution & Governing Law
sections.intro: These Terms & Conditions and any operational disputes arising out of the services rendered on Hamqadam shall be governed by, and construed in conformity with, the civil, penal, and matrimonial laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
sections.closing: Any legal proceeding, claim, or litigation not resolved amicably within thirty (30) days of formal written notification through our legal counsel shall fall under the sole exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts of Islamabad, Pakistan.
